notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans! 

We’re happy to announce that [b]Stray Cats in Cozy Town[/b] is no longer in the limited profile category! Achievements now count towards achievement progress!
Thanks to your incredible support, our cozy hidden-object game has found its forever home in the hearts of many cat lovers around the world. 

And because of your love for this game, we've managed to raise funds for [url=https://www.humanesociety.org/][b]Humane Society[/b][/url], helping life saving program for animals. Your generosity makes a real difference! 

Thank you for being part of this journey with us!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ighb46a.png[/img]

Love and purrs,
The Devcats + Travellin Cats

notes.title: STRAY CATS IN COZY TOWN IS HERE!
notes.content:
Hello hoomans!

International Cat Day is here, and we're excited to announce the release of our latest game, [b]STRAY CATS IN COZY TOWN[/b], now available on Steam!

This hidden-object game invites you to explore Cozy Town and be a part of its community, where every stray cat is fed and loved!

We are also releasing today [b]STRAY CATS IN COZY TOWN: NIGHT LIGHTS[/b], where you'll continue to explore the town, but now during nighttime! This DLC focuses on helping stray cats who are active at night, featuring more than 150 new stray cats to find and help.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993420/Stray_Cats_in_Cozy_Town_Night_Lights/

We'd like to remind you that all net proceeds (less taxes and Steam's cut) from the sales of [b]NIGHT LIGHTS[/b] will be donated to the [b][url=https://www.humanesociety.org/]Humane Society[/url][/b]. Your purchase will directly contribute to the welfare of animals in need, providing them a chance for a better life.

Join us in making a difference! Enjoy a delightful and heartwarming gaming experience. Add [b]STRAY CATS IN COZY TOWN[/b] and [b]NIGHT LIGHTS[/b] to your Steam library today!

Love and purrs,
The Devcats

P.S. We're running our annual [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CatAwarenessFelineSale]CAT AWARENESS FELINE SALE[/url][/b] to celebrate International Cat Day. Join us in this celebration and indulge in Cat Games galore with some hefty discounts!
https://store.steampowered.com/sale/CatAwarenessFelineSale

notes.title: The Humane Society of the United States
notes.content:
Hello hoomans! ːfofinoː

We'd like to announce that the [b]Humane Society[/b] ([url=https://www.humanesociety.org/]https://www.humanesociety.org[/url]) has been chosen to receive the funds from our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2901140/Stray_Cats_in_Cozy_Town/]Stray Cats in Cozy Town[/url][/b] DLC campaign!

[b]The Humane Society of the United States[/b] (HSUS) is a mainstream voice for animals, with active programs in companion animals, wildlife and habitat protection, animals in research, and farm animals. Together with its affiliates, HSUS works across the nation and around the world to protect all animals through legislation, litigation, investigations, education, science, advocacy, and fieldwork. HSUS also rescues and cares for thousands of animals each year, but its primary mission is to prevent cruelty before it occurs. Net proceeds from the game (sales less local sales tax, less Steam percentage) will be directed to life-saving programs for animals, [b]permanently[/b]. 

This decision was made with input from our amazing [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/rr8zmYk9VH]Discord community[/url][/b], who suggested the Humane Society as a worthy recipient of our fundraising efforts. Your participation and love for our feline friends played a crucial role in making this happen. Thank you all for your incredible support and for helping us make a difference in the lives of cats in need.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2993420/Stray_Cats_in_Cozy_Town_Night_Lights/

Our latest game, [b]Stray Cats in Cozy Town[/b], is a hidden-object adventure where we invite you to be part of a community where every cat is respected, loved, and fed. This game will be a short experience, aimed to celebrate [b]International Cat Day[/b] on August 8th.

We will also run our special Cat Awareness Sale from August 8th to the 15th! Be sure to check it out! ːcathspawː

Let's continue to spread love and compassion! Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to check out [b]Stray Cats in Cozy Town[/b] and its [b]DLC[/b] to contribute to this wonderful cause! ːfofino2ː

Love and purrs,
The Devcats & Travellin Cats
